description: §6.8.4 rule 3 holds for a pending cell: `reset-on=[@who]` on `@who` itself is E-RESET-ON-CYCLE. A pending cell's reset is its load's re-run (§13.9.2), so the rule would re-run the load on its own settle, forever.
rationale: §6.8.4 rule 3: "A cycle — including a cell listing itself — is **E-RESET-ON-CYCLE**, naming the cells on the cycle." §13.9.2: "A reset of a pending cell (§6.8) is the request's re-run."
